add.title: Missouri Ends Gender-Affirming Care for Transgender Inmates - Metro Weekly
add.summary: Metro Weekly (11 Jul 2026), reporting on Missouri's law banning gender-affirming care for transgender inmates, records that per the Transitics tracker South Carolina is one of four states (with Tennessee, Arkansas and Utah) holding 'freeze-frame' policies that restrict the treatments transgender inmates may receive while incarcerated. This is the only South Carolina trans-prisoner-specific policy finding surfaced in the mandated search window; it documents an in-prison treatment restriction, not a housing-placement rule, and the article records no South Carolina case or ruling on cell placement, special units, or solitary/segregation for trans prisoners.
